title: Two strands don't work out of the box.
text: Two strands don't work out of the box.. These are very tiny bulbs on a very thin, easily bendable string/line. They are a soft white, almost Amber color when out. I've used these on the top of a fence to illuminate the gate when needed after dark. They just sort of show the area they are on, but don't provide any real light - more of a nightlight effect. I could see using a few of these strings on a Christmas tree actually because they don't get hot.. Unfortunately, out of the six strings of lights in my box, only four actually work.
